title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.4
body_markdown:
*released Jan 9th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.4

### Developer Community

* [Target Android framework cannot be selected when the target runtime for Android is .NET 8 in .NET MAUI](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Target-Android-framework-cannot-be-selec/10515664)
* [The service 'Microsoft.VisualStudio.OLE.Interop.IOleUndoManager' must be installed](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/The-service-MicrosoftVisualStudioOLE/10517246)
* [After upgrade to Visual Studio 17.8.0, Interactive REST Tests no longer work](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/After-upgrade-to-Visual-Studio-1780-I/10514599)
* [Visual Studio 2022 Release 17.8 Hovering over variable in debug at breakpoint does not show value](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-Release-178-Hovering/10518414)
* [17.8 Preview 2 fails to load the IncrediBuild 'Extension Settings' options dialog](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/178-Preview-2-fails-to-load-the-Incredi/10479159)
* [debug single step function does not work anymore in mixed debugger mode and shows error 0x8ede0018](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/debug-single-step-function-does-not-work/10521835)

### Security Advisories Addressed

* [**CVE-2024-20656**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-20656) A vulnerability exists in the VSStandardCollectorService150 service, where local attackers can escalate privileges on hosts where an affected installation of Microsoft Visual Studio is running.
* [**CVE-2023-32027**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-32027) This advisory is republished to address a Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Visual Studio.
* [**CVE-2023-32025**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-32025) This advisory is republished to address a Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Visual Studio.
* [**CVE-2023-32026**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-32026) This advisory is republished to address a Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Visual Studio.
* [**CVE-2023-29356**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-29356) This advisory is republished to address a Microsoft ODBC Driver for SQL Server Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Visual Studio.
* [**CVE-2023-32028**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-32028) This advisory is republished to address a Microsoft SQL OLE DB Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Visual Studio.
* [**CVE-2023-29349**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-29349) This advisory is republished to address a Microsoft ODBC and OLE DB Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Visual Studio.
* [**CVE-2024-0057**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-0057) A security feature bypass vulnerability exists when Microsoft .NET Framework-based applications use X.509 chain building APIs but do not completely validate the X.509 certificate due to a logic flaw.
* [**CVE-2024-0056**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-0056) A vulnerability exists in the Microsoft.Data.SqlClient and System.Data.SqlClient SQL Data provider where an attacker can perform an interception attack (sometimes called a MITM, or man-in-the-middle, attack) between the SQL client and the SQL server.
* [**CVE-2024-21319**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-21319) Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in the ASP.NET Core project templates.
